<EvidenceAnchor id="cov-ptc1b-rail-application" />

- **Coverage ID:** `cov-ptc1b-rail-application`
- **Status:** COVERED

**Reason:** Vmax margin is +4V at the 12V nominal rail and ~2.5V at the tripped-passthrough corner (vs the removed SMD1210P200TF's deterministic -6V violation), and Ihold leaves 0.3A (25%) margin over the 1.2A rail budget at 25C — the accepted trade recorded in decisions.json dec-g-ptc1-replacement.
